latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the "helloworld" skill for OpenClaw.

- Responds to greetings in multiple languages with a matching-language reply.
- Briefly introduces itself as the OpenClaw assistant powered by AI.
- Optionally includes the current time of day in greetings.
- Offers assistance and invites users to state their needs.
- Triggers on greetings or identity questions in any supported language.
